name: SentEdge Widget
author: digitalmosaic

sections.description:
SentEdge Widget lets you add a real-time crypto sentiment widget to any post or page using a simple shortcode or block. Configure your API key, token, and theme in Settings, then add [sentedge_widget] anywhere you want the widget to appear.

Why SentEdge?
* Real-time sentiment insights for crypto markets.
* Lightweight widget that is easy to embed.
* Includes a discreet link back to SentEdge so visitors can explore deeper insights.

Get a free API key here: https://www.sentedge.com/register
sections.installation:
1. Upload the sentedge-widget folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins menu in WordPress.
  3. Go to Settings > SentEdge Widget and enter your API key.
  4. Add [sentedge_widget] or the SentEdge Widget block to any post, page, or template.
sections.faq:
Do I need an API key?

Yes. The SentEdge widget requires a free API key. Sign up here: https://www.sentedge.com/register

What tokens are supported?

Examples include GENERAL_CRYPTO, BTC, ETH, SOL, and more. Refer to SentEdge documentation for the full list.

Can I switch themes?

Yes. Choose light or dark in the settings page.

Can I override token or theme per page?

Yes. Use [sentedge_widget token="BTC" theme="dark"] or set options in the block or Elementor widget.
